Ben — thanks for the heads-up. Short answer: we can support both paths; each has tradeoffs. I attached a short proposal with exact numbers but the summary below should help you decide quickly.

Option A — Credits top-up (recommended if you want to preserve the existing test cadence)
- Add 150k token-equivalent credits to the pilot.
- Price: $2,250 before discount (we price at $0.015 per 1k tokens for this pilot bucket).
- Activation: immediate upon PO/receipt of payment; no config changes; preserved model variant.
- SLA/priority: unchanged. Optional 1-week priority-support add-on available.

Option B — 14-day time extension (recommended if you need calendar time for coordination)
- Extend the pilot end date by 14 days.
- Price: $3,000 flat (covers reserved capacity and ops window).
- Activation: we schedule extension at end of current term.
- SLA/priority: same baseline; we can include 1-week of prioritized scheduling for integration checks.

Tradeoffs: top-up is lower friction and keeps exact spend fungible; extension buys calendar time but is costlier and slightly more operationally involved (we may schedule a maintenance window).

Next steps: I attached RDW-Orion-proposal-v1.pdf with the formal numbers and two short sign-off stubs. If you confirm a preference I can loop in Kimberly for finance sign-off and generate a DocuSign.

Thanks — looping in Priyom for technical notes if you need capacity tuning.
Karthik
